title: Obsessions
writer: Pim de la Parra, Martin Scorsese, Wim Verstappen
actors: Alexandra Stewart, Dieter Geissler, Tom van Beek
plot: A painting falls off the wall in a rented room. The tenant, Nils, a doctorate student in medicine, looks through the little hole in the wall to what happens in his neighbors room. What he sees makes him forget his textbooks quickly.
